main_text.l: Cachinnus] Cachinnatio. Risus maximus, mirus, Cic. Effusus, Claud. Exsertus, Liberalis cachinnus. Latissimo cachinno ad usque intestinorum dolorem redactus, Apul.
Cacodæmon] Genius ater. Genius salax, Hor. Genius sinister, Perf. Orcus, Cic. Vejovis, Id. Læva numina, Virg. Satan, & Satanas, ap. S.S. scriptores.
Cacumen] Columen mentis, Catul. Apex montis, Sil. Supercilium montis, Liv. Vertex, Virg. Jugum, Cæs.
Cadaver] Corpus animâ cassum, Lucr. Mortuale & Morticinium, Hier. Funus, Ter. Reliquiæ hominis.
Cadere] Cadere deorsum, Lucr. Accidere ad terram, Plaut. Prolabi in caput, Liv. Pluit glans de ilice, Virg. Labitur lacryma, Ovid. Collabi, Id. Procidere, Liv. Concidere, Liv. Succidere, Gell.

Cadere præcipitem] Decidere in præceps, Ovid. Ire præcipitem de ponte in lutum per caput pedesque, Catul. Abire præcipitem, Sal. Ferri præcipitem, Cic. Præcipitem ruere, cadere, Virg. Cadere pronum in pectus, Ovid. Præcipitare se de turri, Liv. In flumen, Cæs. Præcipitant pondera, Lucr.
Caduca bona] Caduca hæreditas, Cic. Caducum, Vlp. Bona intestabilium, Paul. IC.
Caducarium jus] Caducaria lex, Vlp. Jus publici ærarii vel fisci.
Caduceator] Caducifer, Ovid. Fecialis, Var. Legatus pacem petens, Fest. Orator pacis petendæ, Liv. Orator fœderum, Cic. Pater-patratus, Liv.
Caduceum] Cerycium, Rhod. Supplicia, Fest. Ramus oleæ, Plaut. (Virga Mercurii erat.)
Caducus morbus] Morbus comitialis, Plin. Morbus major, Celf. Morbus sonticus, Plin. Divinus, Apul. Sacer. Herculeus, Iun. Lues sacra, Deifica, Aurel. Epilepsia.
Cadurcum] Vas, quo aquam haurimus è puteo aut piscinâ, jumento rotam versante, Vall.
Cæcitas] Cæcitas Cyclopis, Tiresiæ, Cic. Orbitas luminis. Caligo oculorum, Scotomia, Plin.
Cæcutiens] Parum videns sæpe offendit, Lusciosus, Vall.

page.notes: Catchword "Cæcu-" at lower right, taken as printed. Some words in the lower entries are faint on the scan; readings such as "Cadere" and "Cadurcum" are believed correct.
